SELECT DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(T1.atom_id))
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3
  ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE
  T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT
  T1.name
FROM races AS T1
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', T1.date) = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', (
    SELECT
      STRFTIME('%Y-%m', MIN(date))
    FROM races
  ));

SELECT
  T2.text
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2
  ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE
  T1.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND T2.language = 'Italian';

SELECT

  AVG(T2.AvgScrWrite)

  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE
  T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'

  T1.School;

SELECT

FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN drivers AS T2

INNER JOIN races AS T3

WHERE

SELECT T1.Currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T2.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT

FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2

WHERE

SELECT T1.id FROM publisher AS T1 WHERE T1.publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Blond'

SELECT

  SUBTRACT(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday), 1900) AS age
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2

INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3

WHERE
  T3.HCT >= 52

HAVING
  COUNT(T3.ID) >= 2;

SELECT
  (
    (
      SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date = '1998-12-27' THEN T1.balance ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date = '1993-03-22' THEN T1.balance ELSE NULL END)
    ) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date = '1998-12-27' THEN T1.balance ELSE NULL END)
  ) * 100.0
FROM trans AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2
  ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T3
  ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS T4
  ON T2.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE
  T3.date = '1993-07-05' AND T1.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27');

SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?';

SELECT
  T1.Segment,
  (
    (MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS Percentage_Increase
FROM yearmonth AS T2
INNER JOIN customers AS T1
  ON T2.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID
WHERE
  T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND (T2.Date LIKE '2012%' OR T2.Date LIKE '2013%')
GROUP BY
  T1.Segment
ORDER BY
  Percentage_Increase DESC
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  T1.Segment,
  (
    (MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN T2.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS Percentage_Increase
FROM yearmonth AS T2
INNER JOIN customers AS T1
  ON T2.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID
WHERE
  T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND (T2.Date LIKE '2012%' OR T2.Date LIKE '2013%')
GROUP BY
  T1.Segment
ORDER BY
  Percentage_Increase ASC
LIMIT 1;

WHERE
  T3.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND T3.expense_date = '2019-08-20';

SELECT DIVIDE(T1.overall_rating - T2.overall_rating, T1.overall_rating) * 100 FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND T2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND T1.date = '2013-07-12'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN publisher AS T2
  ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE
  T2.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT
  T2.colour
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2
  ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3
  ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE
  T3.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY
  T2.colour
ORDER BY
  COUNT(T1.id) DESC;

SELECT
  T1.first_name,
  T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2
  ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY
  T1.member_id
HAVING
  COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 7;

SELECT
  AVG(T1.overall_rating)
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT
  T1.School Name,
  T1.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE
  T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
HAVING
  (
    T1.Enrollment (K-12) - T1.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
  ) > (
    SELECT
      AVG(T3.Enrollment (K-12) - T3.Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
    FROM frpm AS T3
    INNER JOIN schools AS T4
      ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
    WHERE
      T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id)
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
  ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986' AND T2.defensive_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT
  COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2
  ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE
  T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND T2.A3 = 'East Bohemia';
